definitions.explanation: The state of being old or the process of growing old.

examples.japanese: {老|お}い⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{感|かん}じる→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧。
{老|お}い⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{負|ま}けずに→負ける：01134_makeru⟧⟦{元気|げんき}→元気：00696_genki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{暮|く}らしている→暮らす：01937_kurasu⟧。
examples.english: Living well without giving in to old age.

examples.japanese: {老|お}い⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{若|わか}き→若い：00823_wakai⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{一緒|いっしょ}→一緒：02848_issho⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{楽|たの}しめる→楽しむ：01203_tanoshimu⟧⟦イベント→イベント：09594_ibento⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: It's an event that both old and young can enjoy together.

examples.japanese: {老|お}い⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{迎|むか}えて→迎える：01193_mukaeru⟧、⟦{静|しず}かに→静か：00755_shizuka⟧⟦{暮|く}らしたい→暮らす：01937_kurasu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{思|おも}う→思う：00492_omou⟧。
examples.english: As I reach old age, I want to live quietly.

notes:
{老|お}い is a literary or formal noun referring to the state or process of aging. It carries a reflective, sometimes solemn tone and appears frequently in essays, speeches, and proverbs rather than casual conversation.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {老|お}いを⟦{感|かん}じる→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧: to feel one's age
- {老|お}いに⟦{負|ま}ける→負ける：01134_makeru⟧: to succumb to old age
- {老|お}いを⟦{迎|むか}える→迎える：01193_mukaeru⟧: to reach old age
- {老|お}いも⟦{若|わか}きも→若い：00823_wakai⟧: old and young alike (set phrase)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{老人|ろうじん}→老人：03784_roujin⟧: elderly person (neutral, common)
- ⟦{老|お}いる→老いる：04582_oiru⟧: to grow old (verb, literary)
- ⟦{老|ふ}ける→老ける：16742_fukeru⟧: to age, look old (verb, more colloquial)

REGISTER:
More elevated than ⟦{年|とし}→年：00486_toshi⟧を⟦{取|と}ること→取る：00565_toru⟧ (getting older). Used when speaking about aging as a universal human experience.
